motion_rule: he rides a depot loading belt racing at the lens, the camera racing backwards ahead so the parcel stacks tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; the belt carries him every beat and he never works a prop standing; head half the frame and never under a third, from 6.3 a low angle at the same size; new shot size each beat, one action per beat, camera move every beat; the picture fills the frame with no bars
character: a small sand-coloured fennec with huge ears, deadpan
second_characters: ONE scrawny jerboa runner sprinting the belt beside him, vaulting the stacks and hauling nuggets past his nose
props: ONE plain cardboard box with a golden mountain stamped on its side, riding the belt at his knee
prop_continuity: the box stays plain and empty however much gold pours past; the tape ripped off at 2.9 never goes back on
environment: a desert parcel depot at noon, stacks packed to the roof hard against the belt both sides, only a strip of sky above
light_events: hard noon sun through the stack gaps bars his ears every beat, cold rim both sides

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: ko-ROB-ka, o-be-SHCHA-la, zo-lo-TY-ye, GO-ry, KA-zhet-sya, GDE-to, za ug-LOM
audio.pacing: 0.4-3.5 one breath; the gap under one second; 4.4-7.0 one breath with no voice sound outside the lines; after 7.0 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: belt hum, depot roar, tape ripping at 2.9, a rumble ripping along the stacks from 4.4, gold hammering the stack walls from 7.0

timeline.a: he rides the belt at the lens, the box rocking at his knee, stacks tearing past
he hooks a claw under the tape without slowing
he tips the stamped side of the box up to the lens as the belt hauls him on
the jerboa vaults the box at the lens and is carried past it
he rips the tape and throws the flaps wide, the box plain and empty inside
he shakes the open box at the lens on the run and nothing comes out of it
gold bursts out of the stack tearing past at his shoulder, never out of the box
he rears up on the belt, ears swivelling, the fall ripping along the stacks with him
the fall runs down the lane ahead of him, the jerboa vaulting his ears after it
he swings the open box out after the fall as the belt hauls him round the lane corner
the fall jumps the lane and hammers both stack walls past his ears, none of it near him
he thrusts the box up into the falling gold on the run and every nugget skips off the flaps
the jerboa hauls a fistful past his nose and he swipes and misses
he throws himself into the lens, deadpan, the empty box on his head, gold pouring past behind

must_appear: one plain box with a stamped golden mountain; at 2.9 it is empty; from 4.4 gold bursts out of the stacks racing past him, never out of the box; at 7.8 nothing lands in it; at 9.3 his deadpan face is in the lens, the box on his head
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal bars, night, an empty desert horizon, a wire fence, a distant background, standing bystanders, a still background, a parked camera, a hero standing to work on a prop, a hero digging, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, gold coming out of the box, gold landing in the box, a word not in the lines, a drawn-out word, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra limbs
